newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 24.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Workers of agro-industrial group Palmindustrie begin indefinite strike over redloyment in the recently privatised company.
- Student leader threatens trouble at university campuses at start of term in January if four arrested colleagues are not freed.

- Interior Minister Emile Constant Bombe announces reinforced security measures ahead of December 29 partial legislative elections around central town of Gagnoa. Voting in the main election late last year was postponed there because of political violence.

- Air Ivoire back on path of growth and has even opened up new routes in West Africa. The state carrier is one of key enterprises left on Ivory Coast's privatisation list. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
